content: ⌊ DRAFT g Each SwCluC_LdCom- Proxy_LdComCbkTpTxConfirmation notification callback, where the parameter LdComUserCallbackType (See [ECUC_LdCom_00025]) is set to LDCOM_TP_TX_CONFIRMATION , shall be configured as SwCluC_LdComProxy_<BS>_LdComCbkTpTxConfirmation , where <BS> is the shortName of the SwCluCLdComProxyBaseSocket container.
